soundtrack.music: Upbeat modern pop for a study app ad: punchy kick, bright plucked synth arpeggio, claps on two and four, a confident lift when the plan appears, tight button ending. Around 122 BPM, optimistic and focused. No vocals.

proof.narration: Sınavika eksik konularını tek tek gösterir.

product.narration: Ders Planı onları günlük görevlere çevirir.
